external_dataset.title: Software Requirements Classification: From Bag-of-Words to Transformer [Dataset]
external_dataset.label_provenance: The curated workbook already supplies FR/NFR in its Type column. The dataset description reports manual FR/NFR labelling by the authors where labels were missing. This experiment does not map security/non-security categories to FR/NFR.
external_dataset.adaptation: Select the CPN and ePurse sections. Remove conflicting FR/NFR duplicate groups, extra same-label copies and any normalized matches with the original corpus. Retained text and Type labels are unchanged.
external_dataset.age_note: The 2025 release is a curated compilation of older source specifications, not newly collected 2025 requirements.
